main.description: A heart: liking something in the tile family. Shown as hearts in Raku. Usually on a tile post (cafe.thunderbird.tile.post); possibly on a tile (ing.dasl.masl). Readers ignore subjects they don't show. Deleting the record takes the heart back.

subject.description: What is hearted (usually a cafe.thunderbird.tile.post record) and its exact version.
